WITH behavior_by_type AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(ab.abhvreg) as behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(behavior_count) as total_count FROM behavior_by_type
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    bbt.tradekind,
    bbt.behavior_count,
    CAST(bbt.behavior_count AS REAL) / CAST(t.total_count AS REAL) as share
  FROM behavior_by_type bbt
  CROSS JOIN totals t
  WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM with_shares
)
SELECT 
  ws.tradekind,
  ws.behavior_count,
  ws.share,
  ws.share - a.avg_share as share_minus_avg
FROM with_shares ws
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL
  AND ws.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY ws.tradekind
